blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
On the phone, being polite is being professional. We use can I and can you all the time. For example: "Can I speak to Ana?" or "Can you repeat that, please?"

These small words are simple, but they help a lot. They are clear, and everyone understands them. You sound kind and easy to work with.

Today you learn five useful words and you practise a lot. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: What is the text about?
items.why: O texto fala sobre ser educado ao telefone usando "can I" e "can you".

items.q: Which words does the text ask you to use?
items.why: "We use can I and can you all the time."

items.q: According to the text, why are these words good?
options: They are clear and everyone understands them
items.why: "They are clear, and everyone understands them."

items.q: The text says "take your time." The writer would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: You should hurry and speak very fast.
items.why: Inferência: "take your time" quer dizer o contrário de correr; o autor não quer que você fale rápido demais.

items.q: "You sound kind and easy to work with" suggests that polite words…
options: help you build a good relationship
items.why: Inferência: soar gentil e fácil de trabalhar junto ajuda o relacionamento profissional.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie no telefone com um colega da Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello. This is Sophie from Czarnikow. Can I speak to Mark, please?

Oh, he is in a meeting? That is okay. Can you take a message for me? Thank you.

Please tell him I called. Can you ask him to call me back later? My number is easy. Can I give it to you now?

It is five, five, five, one, two, three, four. Can you repeat it, please? Yes, that is right. Thank you very much.

One more thing. Can you spell his name for me? I want to write it right. M, A, R, K. Perfect.

Thank you for your help. Have a good day. Goodbye.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who does Sophie want to speak to?
items.why: "Can I speak to Mark, please?"

items.q: Why can't Sophie speak to him?
items.why: "Oh, he is in a meeting?"

items.q: What does Sophie ask the colleague to do?
items.why: "Can you take a message for me?"

items.q: Why does Sophie ask the colleague to repeat the number?
options: She wants the number to be correct
items.why: Inferência: ela pede para repetir e confirma ("that is right") para ter certeza que o número está certo.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie on the call?
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "please" e "thank you" muitas vezes e fala com calma — é educada.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Hello, can I speak to Ana?" Hello means…
items.why: Hello = alô/oi, a saudação ao atender ou começar a ligação.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Can I ___ to the manager, please?"
items.why: Speak = falar. "Can I speak to the manager?"

items.q: "Can you hold, please?" To hold on the phone means to…
items.why: Hold = aguardar na linha por um momento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "He is busy now. Can I leave a ___?"
items.why: Message = recado. "Can I leave a message?"

items.q: "Can you call me later?" Later means…
items.why: Later = mais tarde, num momento futuro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no telefone. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you call back in ten minutes?" To call back means to…
items.why: Call back = ligar de volta, telefonar de novo.

items.q: "Please hold on a second." Hold on means…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento, aguarde na linha.

items.q: "Can you speak up, please? I can't hear you." Speak up means…
items.why: Speak up = falar mais alto para ser ouvido.

items.q: "He is not here. Can I take a message?" To take a message means to…
options: write down a note for someone
items.why: Take a message = anotar um recado para outra pessoa.

items.q: "Sorry, wrong number. Let me hang up." To hang up means to…
items.why: Hang up = desligar o telefone, encerrar a ligação.
